propositions.proposition_text: All catches below the applicable minimum conservation reference size retained on board a United Kingdom fishing vessel must be placed in boxes, compartments or containers in such a way that they are identifiable from other boxes, compartments or containers.
propositions.display_label: Article 49a(1) — Segregation of sub-MCRS catches (identifiability requirement)
propositions.subject: United Kingdom fishing vessel operator retaining catches below minimum conservation reference size
propositions.rule: must place sub-MCRS catches in boxes, compartments or containers so that they are identifiable from other boxes, compartments or containers
propositions.object: catches below the applicable minimum conservation reference size retained on board
conditions: catches are below the applicable minimum conservation reference size
catches are retained on board a United Kingdom fishing vessel
propositions.evidence_text: All catches below the applicable minimum conservation reference size retained on board a United Kingdom fishing vessel shall be placed in boxes, compartments or containers in such a way that they are identifiable from other boxes, compartments or containers.
propositions.reason: First sentence of Article 49a(1) imposes a clear, self-contained obligation on vessel operators regarding physical segregation and identifiability of sub-MCRS catches.

propositions.proposition_text: Catches below the applicable minimum conservation reference size retained on board a United Kingdom fishing vessel must not be mixed with any other fishery products.
propositions.display_label: Article 49a(1) — Prohibition on mixing sub-MCRS catches with other fishery products
propositions.subject: United Kingdom fishing vessel operator retaining catches below minimum conservation reference size
propositions.rule: must not mix sub-MCRS catches with any other fishery products
propositions.object: catches below the applicable minimum conservation reference size retained on board
conditions: catches are below the applicable minimum conservation reference size
catches are retained on board a United Kingdom fishing vessel
propositions.evidence_text: Those catches shall not be mixed with any other fishery products.
propositions.reason: Second sentence of Article 49a(1) imposes a distinct prohibition — no mixing with other fishery products — which is legally separate from the identifiability/segregation obligation in the first sentence and warrants its own proposition.
